## Stop PID demand when the target is reached

PID now ends its current logical duty cycle when the fresh control reading reaches the active target:

| Direction | Demand becomes zero |
| --- | --- |
| Heating | Temperature is at or above the heating target |
| Cooling | Temperature is at or below the cooling target |
| Humidifying | Humidity is at or above the humidity target |
| Dehumidifying / DRY | Humidity is at or below the humidity target |

This clears residual integral, cached positive output and profile wake requests immediately, even before the next PID sample. An explicitly selected heating direction no longer depends on the unrelated cooling target to qualify for shutdown, and vice versa.

Fresh readings are checked before active commands and again after persistence or a busy command queue. Obsolete ON, setpoint and fan commands are not repeated after the target is satisfied. Previously issued commands keep their acknowledgement evidence and bounded retry history; renewed demand before physical shutdown continues the original remaining budget.

Native OFF still respects the existing minimum run time, defrost, ownership and availability checks. The per-device **Timed setpoints (30 s)** option remains off by default; enabled devices retain their reverse-setpoint shutdown sequence. A cutoff cancels PID demand immediately but does not bypass these physical protections. The separate power supply is never disconnected to force a running appliance off.

Devices authorized only for setpoint control reduce their old PID boost through the existing bounded adjustments. They do not gain power-control permission.

The status sensor reports zero demand during a target cutoff and exposes `pid_target_reached`, `pid_control_target` and `pid_control_measurement`. The comparison uses HEM's configured room control sensors or their valid average, which can differ from the native device's own temperature display.

Validation covers the real runtime with simulated Home Assistant transport, including target crossings before the next sample, all four control directions, percentage valves, pending commands, late acknowledgements, retry races, minimum run times and the optional 30-second sequence. Physical valve closure is not inferred from Home Assistant's reported mode.

Update in HACS and restart Home Assistant.
